'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Chris Terwilliger LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Username:''' Vader322
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
